summary: West Fraser Timber Co. Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a June 3, 2026 news release announcing the issuance of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The filing is a routine disclosure of sustainability performance, including emissions reductions, carbon credit sales, and biodiversity initiatives. There are no terms such as price per share, stake percentage, or premium. No board recommendation or advisor is named. No deal mechanics, regulatory clock, or risk-arb angle applies. This is not a special situation; it is a standard periodic update from a foreign private issuer.
